recreation_brief:
1. Slide setup: create a 16:9 slide (13.33in x 7.5in) and fill the entire background with very light gray #F5F5F5.
2. Border frame: draw one rectangle with no fill and a ~2pt dark-red #C00000 outline spanning ~4%-96% of slide width and ~4%-96% of slide height (inset ~4-5% from all four edges); it encloses every element except the bottom black strip.
3. Slide-number badge: draw one oval spanning ~88%-94% horizontal and ~8%-16% vertical (~0.8in wide x ~0.6in tall), filled pale yellow #FFFF99 with a ~1.5pt purple #6633CC outline; center the numeral '2' inside it in small (~12pt) regular-weight dark-gray #333333 sans-serif.
4. Title line 1: add a centered text box spanning ~25%-75% horizontal with its top edge at ~30-35% of slide height; type 'Transformers' in extra-bold sans-serif (e.g., Arial Black or Arial Bold), ~54-60pt, red #C00000, center-aligned.
5. Title line 2: directly below 'Transformers', add the centered line 'Part II' in bold sans-serif, ~32-36pt (55-60% of the title size), red #C00000.
6. Title line 3: directly below 'Part II', add the centered line 'Aug. 2020' in bold italic sans-serif, ~18-20pt (30-35% of the title size), red #C00000; keep the three lines tightly stacked as one centered block occupying ~30%-60% of slide height.
7. Pen-cursor icon: place one small pen/stylus icon (~0.3in tall, angled diagonally; dark-gray #333333 outline with #888888 shading; use Insert > Icons or a freeform pen shape) centered at ~45% horizontal and ~66% vertical, just below 'Aug. 2020' and slightly left of horizontal center.
8. Bottom strip: draw one rectangle spanning the full slide width from ~95% to 100% vertical (~0.4in tall), filled solid black #000000 with no outline, overlapping/below the red border at the very bottom edge.
9. Final check: the slide must contain exactly 4 shapes (red border rectangle, yellow badge oval, pen icon, black bottom strip), 3 stacked red text lines ('Transformers', 'Part II', 'Aug. 2020'), and the badge numeral '2' - no other text, images, or charts.
